payload.text: hv, 19 Oct 2026, directly to vc, on vc's recommendation to drop depends_on :macos from the formula in 2.14.1: "Yep, agree. It can't only depend on macOS. We need to make it work on both Linux and macOS and the bits that can't work as-is outside macOS (ie menubar app) degrade sensibly in non-macOS environments." The same yes reached kovacs-sysadm in its session, which withdrew the post-cut checkout runbook for kovacs: after the cut and hv's tap push, kovacs runs brew tap matthewsinclair/utilz, brew install utilz and utilz doctor, each at hv's approval there, on vc's go. vc's reading: 2.14.1 carries Utilz on Linux as an issue of its own, utilz-dc's, design first. The formula drops depends_on :macos; every utility either works on Linux or degrades by name (the menu bar app, arngz's Hammerspoon desks, macoz, and what the audit finds); utilz doctor reports a macOS-only utility as not available here rather than as missing dependencies. The existing guards (macoz:26, clipz:26, common.sh:346, :376, :898) start the audit. It lands after 0080, whose run_doctor change it builds on.
